description: This file defines a class DauxExtension that implements a configurable extension for the Markdown environment, specifically for the Daux content type extension in a documentation generator. It includes configuration schema setup and event listener registration.

classes.name: DauxExtension
classes.description: A final class implementing a configurable extension for the Markdown environment, providing schema configuration and event handling for document parsing.

methods.name: configureSchema
methods.description: Configures the schema for the extension, adding a 'daux' schema expecting a Config class instance.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers an event listener for the DocumentParsedEvent that invokes the onDocumentParsed method of AutoTOCAdder.
